captions.text: The music settles softly on C major, then at 166.3 the violas, Horn 1 and Clarinet 1 move from E4 to E♭4 and the cellos from E3 to E♭3. The coda begins in C minor at bar 167.
captions.check: recTwo.ily recTwoVla (recTwoSync last bar), recTwoHnOne, recTwoClOne 166 (E4 to E♭4 at beat 3), recTwoVc (recTwoArp last bar, E3 to E♭3), recTwoCb C2; chords from all parts at 166.1 and 166.3.

captions.short: Coda: first theme ff, then the stop chord
captions.text: The coda (letter L) brings the head of the first theme ff in Horns 1·2, Trumpets 1·2 and violas over a C pedal. At bar 170 the stop chord from bar 26 sounds over C under a fermata, and the trumpets end on B4.
captions.check: coda.ily codaHnOne/Two, codaTptOne/Two, codaVla 167–169 over codaVc/codaCb C; bar 170 fermata, themes-mvt1.ly mvtOneStopChord (third chord, over C); codaTptOne B4.

captions.short: Cello solo: second theme in C minor
captions.text: A solo cello plays the second theme in C minor while the cor anglais plays the motto, G4–E♭5–D5–C5–D♭5–C5. The D♭ major chord at bar 173 (a Neapolitan sixth) leads to C minor over G and then to G.
captions.check: coda.ily codaVc (solo) 171–174 (themes-mvt1.ly mvtOneThemeSCodaMinor), codaCorAnglais 171–174 (mvtOneMottoCodaCA); chords from all parts at 173.3, 174.1, 174.3.

captions.short: Trombone chorale: the motto in long notes
captions.text: The trombones play the motto as a pp chorale in long notes (Trombone 1 G3–E♭4–D4–C4–D♭4–C4), with bass clarinet, cellos and basses on the bass line and a pp tam-tam stroke. Clarinet 1 recalls the horn call, E♭4–C5–B4.
captions.check: coda.ily codaTbnOne/Two, codaBassTbn 175–179 (themes-mvt1.ly mvtOneMottoChorale), codaBassCl, codaVc, codaCb, codaPerc tam-tam pp; codaClOne 175–177 (mvtOneHornCallCoda).

captions.short: Violins I: the motto, two bars behind
captions.text: Violins I play the motto pp espressivo, G4–E♭5–D5–C5–D♭5–C5, about two bars after the trombones: the trombones reach E♭ at bar 176 and the violins at bar 178.
captions.check: coda.ily codaVlnOne 177.4–181 (themes-mvt1.ly mvtOneMottoViolins) against codaTbnOne 175–179.

captions.short: Last chord: violas turn C minor to C major
captions.text: Over C minor, on the last chord the violas alone move from E♭4 to E4, ppp, so the movement ends on C major. Violins, violas, cellos and Horn 3 hold the chord into Movement II, which follows attacca.
captions.check: coda.ily codaVla 181–182 (E♭4 to E4), codaVlnOne, codaVlnTwo, codaVc, codaHnThree tied at the end; mvt2 intro.ily bar 1 holds the same chord.

review.problem: The D♭/F chord was placed at 7.3, but Violins II, violas, cellos and basses change to F–D♭–A♭–F on the downbeat of bar 7 (intro.ily introVlnTwo f'1, introVla des'1, introVc aes1, introCb f,1), so the label came two beats (2.4 s) late.
review.fix: Moved the D♭/F chord name to 7.1.

review.problem: Called the move to F minor at 64 a deceptive cadence straight from E♭7. On beat 3 of bar 63 the basses and Bassoon 2 move to E♮ (tTwoCb es,2 e,2), so the harmony passes through a diminished seventh E–G–B♭–D♭ into F minor; the exposition's deceptive cadence (V7 to vi) is at 67–68.
review.fix: Rewrote short and text to describe the rising bass E♭–E♮–F, added the chord 'E dim7' at 63.3, and added a separate note for the real deceptive cadence at 67–68.

review.problem: The file had no note for the deceptive cadence that closes the second-theme group (E♭7 at 67 to F minor at 68); the analyst had cut it for spacing and placed the term wrongly at 64.
review.fix: Added a Harmony note 67.1–69.1 (4.7 s) anchored on Violins I with chords E♭7 and F minor.

review.problem: The note is about the bass A♭–E–C–A♭, but its bracket was on the cellos from 78.3; the cellos rest in bar 77 and play head fragments (B2–G3…, G2–E♭3, G3–E♭4), not that bass line, which is in the double basses (devCb A♭1, A♭1/E2, E2, C2, C2, A♭1).
review.fix: Moved the anchor to Double basses 77.1–83.1 and raised the 77–81 split's lower zoom from 1.4 to 1.5 so the basses' staff sits well inside the lower panel.

review.problem: Said A♭6 is 'a minor ninth above the G pedal'; the pedal is G1/G2, so the interval is several octaves plus a semitone. A♭ is the minor ninth of the G chord (mvt1.md: 'A♭ as the minor ninth of V').
review.fix: Reworded to 'the minor ninth of the dominant chord over the G pedal'.

review.problem: The return of the stop chord in the recapitulation was missing (the analyst cut it for spacing). It is a motive's return with a changed outcome: bass D instead of B, and F minor at 139 instead of C minor, followed by the Neapolitan D♭ at 140 under Flute 1's A♭6.
review.fix: Added a Harmony note 138.1–143.1 (9.6 s) anchored on Flutes 1·2 with chords B dim7/D, F minor, D♭, G; it fills the 15 s gap between the notes at 131 and 143.

review.problem: Said the cor anglais fills 'the pauses'; the tune has no pauses in 147–150. The cor anglais enters on the half-beats inside the tune's held notes (147.3.5, 149.3.5; recTwo.ily c378 'fills inside the tune's held notes').
review.fix: Reworded to 'adding short phrases inside the tune's long notes'.

review.problem: Started at 177.3, a beat before the violins enter (codaVlnOne G4 at 177.4); with the new Clarinet 1 / trombones split running to 177.4 its Violins I anchor would have been outside both panels for that beat.
review.fix: Moved 'from' to 177.4, the violins' entry (10.0 s).

review.problem: Ended at 64.1 in the middle of the phrase: Clarinet 1 and Horn 2 keep playing the counter-melody against the violins' tune through 64–68 (tTwoClOne/tTwoHnTwo c'2 r8 c'8 d'8 es'8 | des'2 aes'2 | des'4 aes'8 g'8 bes'2~ | bes'2 g'4 des'4 | c'1), the same texture the split shows, so the view returned to one staff while both lines continued.
review.fix: Extended to 68.3 (bars 56–68, the whole phrase A', 26.8 s); updated what, check and bars.

review.problem: Said 'bass clarinet with Clarinet 1 (77)', which reads as a doubling; the bass clarinet plays the head at 77.1 (E♭2) and Clarinet 1 answers at 77.3 (E♭5), and the two staves are neighbours, not far apart.
review.fix: Reworded to describe the answer three octaves higher; lower zoom 1.4 → 1.5 to hold the double basses for the 77–82 note's new anchor.

review.problem: Said Horn 1 and the violas play in unison through 147–153; they are in unison only in 147–150 (recTwoHnOne g4 e'2 d'4 against recTwoVla g'4 e''2 d''4 at 151, octaves again at 152, and Horn 1 rests at 153). It also said the cor anglais fills 'the pauses'.
